updates.content:
Title: Users may be unable to convert Microsoft Word desktop app documents to PDFs using Save As to SharePoint locations

User impact: Users may be unable to convert Microsoft Word desktop app documents to PDFs using Save As to SharePoint locations.

More info: This issue is reported to affect Microsoft Word version 2609, and some users report that version 2608 isn't affected. No error is presented and the file is instead saved to the “C:\Users\username\AppData\Local\Microsoft\Windows\INetCache\Content.MSO” folder with an incorrect file name.
 
Additionally, this only reported to only impact converting Microsoft Word desktop app documents to PDFs using Save As and SharePoint Online as the location.
 
While we're focused on remediation, users that have the option to save the file locally to their computer may use this to work around the problem. Additionally, using the Export to PDF function works as expected.

Current status: We're investigating a potential issue with Microsoft Word saving files as PDF to SharePoint Online, and we're checking for impact to your organization. We'll provide an update within 60 minutes.
